history.compatibility: Breaking for SourceConnector only: classify(item): SourceSensitivity is removed and replaced by classificationSignals(item): SourceClassificationSignals (source facts only; the shared four-tier classifier decides). Every in-tree connector moved in the same change. EvidencePack (1.1.0, optional coverage matchCounts) and Analyst shapes are unchanged by this version. Storage placement is unchanged: each lane declares the placement its connector's classify() returned (ConnectorStoreSyncOptions.placement), so no item moves and no vector changes.
history.migrationReceipt: docs/CONTRACTS.md change log 2026-09-23 (SourceConnector 2.0.0): no stored-data migration in this version. Declared-placement lanes keep every row and vector: test/tier-p1a-storage-unchanged.test.ts proves byte-identical items, chunks and vectors with and without the tier ledger, and that re-syncing never re-embeds or reaches invalidateEmbeddingModelCurrency; test/tier-p1a-review-fixes.test.ts pins per-lane parity with the retired classify() answers. Gmail and Drive keep the shared raise-only classification policy; their re-fetch path now uses that policy instead of the connector's own classify(), so there the guarantee is the unchanged policy, not byte identity. The tier ledger is a new, additive SQLite file co-located with each store and covered by data delete. Moving items between tier stores is phase P1b (design section 4.6, owner-approved batches).

history.compatibility: Additive and optional (docs/design/child-items.md): SourceItemIdentity.parent, RawItem.deferredBytes (locator, available, sizeBytes), a second optional argument to SourceConnector.fetchItem carrying the persisted locator, and SourceCitationMetadata.parentLabel. history.migrationReceipt: docs/CONTRACTS.md change log 2026-10-25 (SourceConnector and EvidencePack 2.1.0). The connector store gains four nullable items columns (parent_local_item_id, deferred_locator, bytes_available, size_bytes) and an index on the parent as an additive schema migration; existing rows have no parent and do not move. test/child-items-storage-unchanged.test.ts proves existing items, chunks and vectors are byte-identical before and after the migration, following test/tier-p1a-storage-unchanged.test.ts. A child is shown only while its parent is, by a read-time check that records nothing (no ledger change); the archive record gains an append-only media-binding table (a SQLite file beside the record, raw/archive-media-bindings.sqlite, written before the child row and not hashed into a resume point); the extraction job store gains a forget step by (corpus, account scope). No embedding model or epoch changes: children are new items, embedded as any new item is.

history.compatibility: Additive and optional (docs/design/archive-live-one-dataset.md): RawItem.holdContentUntilJudged, SourceConnectorListOptions.storedItem (a StoredItemLookup that answers with a StoredItemState: the stored version and whether the item holds content), and SourceConnector.forInput (a SourceConnectorInput: an inputId, a kind of live or archive, and records in SourceRecordPage form). A connector that omits them, and a consumer that ignores them, behave as under 2.1.0; a listItems that ignores its options still satisfies the interface. A source has one connector and it is the only writer: the live reader is one input, each imported archive is another that emits the live reader's own record shape, and each input keeps its own cursor under its own connector id, so an archive never moves the live cursor. Whether a record applies is decided against what the store holds before the item is built (newer in the source's own order applies; at the same version only a record that brings content the stored item lacks; live wins a tie), by the one shared rule in src/core/source-inputs.ts, which keeps no state of its own. The hold travels with the item: placement honours RawItem.holdContentUntilJudged exactly as it honours the lane option of the same name, through first classification and child extraction, and a persisted hold keeps applying to the item's later versions, a live replacement included, until the private model has judged it, so a live replacement of a held item errs Private. EvidencePack and Analyst shapes are unchanged; the Analyst prompt is unchanged and no question logic is added.
history.migrationReceipt: docs/CONTRACTS.md change log 2026-10-25 (SourceConnector and RawItem 2.2.0). No stored data migration: the connector store schema is unchanged (the lookup reads existing columns), no item moves and no embedding model or epoch changes. The archive record gains optional fields only (the source an import is an input of, and its intake counts); an existing record has none and reads as before, and no row is re-keyed. The data lifecycle gains one forget step (archive-imports-of-source, before source-account-bindings) so a whole-source delete removes the imports that were part of the source, with their media bindings and continuation-cache entries, and keeps every other import. Proof: test/source-inputs.test.ts (the rule and the hold through a real store set) and test/one-pipeline-spine.test.ts (a fixture source with a live and an archive input, through the real import, approval, tier set and lifecycle delete).
